chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus who said:

I said to Hisham: Your companions relate that Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) sent a message to you via Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj saying: 'Abstain from speaking.' Hisham ibn Salim said: Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj came to me and said to me: Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) says to you: 'Abstain from speaking in these days.' Al-Mahdi had compiled for him the theological positions of the people, and among them was the position of the Jawaliqiyya, Hisham ibn Salim. He read that book in al-Sharqiyya but did not mention Hisham's speech. Yunus claimed that Hisham ibn al-Hakam said to him: 'So I abstained from speaking entirely until al-Mahdi died, for he had said to me 'in these days,' so I abstained until al-Mahdi died.'

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan (Imam al-Rida, peace be upon him)
key_terms.عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَجَّاج: Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj (messenger of the Imam)

ai.seo_question: Why did the Imam advise his companions to abstain from speaking during the caliphate of al-Mahdi?
ai.summary: This account from Rijal al-Kashshi illustrates the strategic policy of *al-samt* (strategic silence) adopted by Imam al-Rida (AS) during the reign of Caliph al-Mahdi, who had compiled a comprehensive book of theological debates (*Maqalat*) including Hisham ibn Salim's views. While the instruction was initially for specific days, Hisham ibn al-Hakam interpreted it as a prolonged period of silence until the Caliph's death, highlighting the delicate balance between preserving theological integrity and avoiding political persecution in the Abbasid court.

en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/276] Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh from Muhammad b. Isa from Yunus who said:

I said to Hisham: Your companions relate that Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام sent a message to you and Hisham b. Salim via Abd al-Rahman b. al-Hajjaj saying: ‘abstain from speaking [making theological disputations]’.He [Hisham] said: Abd al-Rahman b. al-Hajjaj came to me and said: Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام says to you: ‘abstain from speaking in these days’ - because it had been authored for al-Mahdi [the Caliph] [a treatise containing] the theological positions of the people. In it were the theological positions of the Jawaliqiyya [followers] of Hisham b. Salim. This treatise was publicly read in Sharqiyya [a district in Baghdad] but the position of Hisham [b. al-Hakam] was not mentioned.Yunus claims that Hisham b. al-Hakam said to him: I abstained from speaking totally until al-Mahdi died, for he [the Imam] had said ‘in these days’ - so he stopped until al-Mahdi died.
